answer: Slow payout queue: payments to any agent identity stay locked 30 days and require one camera calibration against a supplied pigment card. Each clone must buy its own calibration card and hardware key, then wait the same 30 days, while an honest agent reuses its key. A duplicate calibration using a willow-pattern card is rejected and forfeits the full fee. The verifier checks a falcon watermark locally, so cloning multiplies fixed fees and delay rather than income.
